_doc: Example packs the platform knows. 'mcai examples download <id>' fetches the manifest from manifest_url (this project's GitHub releases only), checks it against manifest_sha256, then fetches and checks every section. Regenerate with scripts/build-examples.sh.

packs.title: Atlantis Lite
packs.description: A 96-block-wide cutaway of the underwater city: the central tower, a district with the Fountain Plaza, a pier with landing pads, the dome wall and the sea floor. Quick to install (about a minute).

packs.title: Atlantis Full
packs.description: The whole city under a 1,200-block glass dome: ten districts, six piers and the sea floor around it, in 90 sections. Needs a deep ocean about 1,600 x 1,600 blocks wide; take a backup first.
